name: doubao-multimodal
title_zh: 音视频丢给它，回来的是字幕、时间轴和谁在说话
tagline_zh: 开会录音、采访视频、技术讲座——不用本地装 Whisper，豆包多模态直接出带时间戳的字幕、说话人分离和关键帧。
tagline_en: No local Whisper needed. Send meeting recordings or videos to Doubao-Seed and get timestamped subtitles, speaker.
desc_en: Async audio/video understanding with Doubao-Seed (火山方舟 Ark). Handles ASR (plain / per-character timestamps / multispeaker), AST translation, speaker diarization, subtitle alignment, audio-visual captioning, video timeline JSON, technical-blog keyframe selection (with optional transcript hint), and free-form prompts over an audio or video file. Auto-uploads local files to Volcano TOS and auto-downl
why_zh: 它把火山方舟的多模态能力包成了顺手工具：自动传 TOS、自动下载结果，ASR 还分纯文本/逐字时间戳/。
why_en: Wraps Doubao-Seed's multimodal API into a smooth pipeline: auto-upload to TOS, auto-fetch results, and ASR with three.
limit_zh: 只认火山方舟的豆包模型，需要你已有 Ark API Key 且开通 TOS 存储；本地文件必须能上传。
limit_en: Requires Volcano Ark API key + TOS bucket. Local file upload size limited by bandwidth/TOS chunks. Subtitle alignment is timeline-based only, no.
title_en: Drop audio/video, get subtitles, timeline & speaker labels
